simple.meaning: זֵרֹעַ (zêrôaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “something sown (only in the plural), i.e. a vegetable (as food).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זֵרֹעַ (H2235) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 1:12, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זֵרֹעַ (H2235) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in זֵרֹעַ (H2235) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: זֵרֹעַ (zêrôaʻ) / H2235 is traced through Daniel 1:12, Daniel 1:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
